newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul creditors to extend Jinro Const payment.
newsitem.headline: Seoul creditors to extend Jinro Const payment.

text.p: South Korean creditor banks decided to extend principal payments for Jinro Construction Co until July 25, 1998, creditor banks said on Friday.
The banks also said they decided to split up and sell Jinro Mass Merchandising Inc to a third party. The bail-out programme for that company would be extended for two months, they said.
Preferential lending rates would be applied to Jinro Construction's principal payments, creditor banks said.
Creditor banks had earlier decided to supply 36.9 billion won to Jinro Ltd.
The creditors were still deciding the future of the three remaining Jinro Group affiliates--Jinro Industries Co, Jinro General Foods Co and Jinro Coors Brewing Co.
